mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the bank on which the bill or raft is drawn."
vii) The paying bank is the bank on which the bill or raft is drawn.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a written promise made by one person (the maker) to another (usually the payee) payable either on demand or at a definite time."
A promissory note is a written promise made by one person (the maker) to another (usually the payee) payable either on demand or at a definite time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a contract to perform the promise, or discharge the liability of a third person in case of default."
A contract of guarantee is a contract to perform the promise, or discharge the liability of a third person in case of default.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an unconditional order to pay by which the party creating the draft, that is the drawer, orders another party, that is the drawee, typically a bank, to pay money to a third party, that is the payee."

A bank draft is an unconditional order to pay by which the party creating the draft, that is the drawer, orders another party, that is the drawee, typically a bank, to pay money to a third party, that is the payee.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the correspondent bank that is situated in the same place as the seller, and advises the credit to the seller."
iv) The notifying bank is the correspondent bank that is situated in the same place as the seller, and advises the credit to the seller.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered ideal as banking securities."
The negotiable securities are considered ideal as banking securities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an account that is characterized by tax benefits for saving in country such as Canada."
The Tax-Free Savings Account is an account that is characterized by tax benefits for saving in country such as Canada.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the medium of exchange authorized or adopted by the country of origin, which can easily be converted into foreign currency."
Payable in money means the medium of exchange authorized or adopted by the country of origin, which can easily be converted into foreign currency.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a document issued by a dock company stating that the goods described therein are deliverable to the person named in the warrant, or to his assignee by endorsement."
The 'dock warrant' is a document issued by a dock company stating that the goods described therein are deliverable to the person named in the warrant, or to his assignee by endorsement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as the right to retain property belonging to a debtor until he has discharged the debt due to the retainer of the property."
A 'lien' may be defined as the right to retain property belonging to a debtor until he has discharged the debt due to the retainer of the property.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the signature of the drawer or holder of a negotiable instrument for the purpose of negotiation."
An 'endorsement' is the signature of the drawer or holder of a negotiable instrument for the purpose of negotiation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the difference between the book value and the discounted value of the accounts receivable."
The factoring interest is the difference between the book value and the discounted value of the accounts receivable.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the party that delivers property to another."
Bailor is the party that delivers property to another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a rebuttable presumption that makes the free transfer of negotiable instruments feasible in the modern economy."
The holder-in-due-course rule is a rebuttable presumption that makes the free transfer of negotiable instruments feasible in the modern economy.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered as stale when it has been in circulation for more than six months and bankers return such cheques for the drawer's confirmation."
Generally a cheque is considered as stale when it has been in circulation for more than six months and bankers return such cheques for the drawer's confirmation.
fib: ______ is a financial account between a bank customer and a financial institution.
bank account
A bank account is a financial account between a bank customer and a financial institution.
______ is a general lien, which confers a right to retain properties in respect of any general balance due by the debtor to the banker.
banker's lien
A banker's lien is a general lien, which confers a right to retain properties in respect of any general balance due by the debtor to the banker.
______ is the party to whom the property is delivered.
Bailee
Bailee is the party to whom the property is delivered.
______ may be defined as a transfer, by way of security of the general ownership of the chattel, subject to the equity of redemption of the mortgagor.
'mortgage of movables
A 'mortgage of movables' may be defined as a transfer, by way of security of the general ownership of the chattel, subject to the equity of redemption of the mortgagor.
______ is a document issued by a warehouse-keeper containing the same statement.
warehouse warrant
A warehouse warrant is a document issued by a warehouse-keeper containing the same statement.
______ is the same as "I promise to pay you on demand" and if the latter words do not have the effect of restricting negotiability, the former cannot have that effect.
implication these words
The implication these words is the same as "I promise to pay you on demand" and if the latter words do not have the effect of restricting negotiability, the former cannot have that effect.
______ are used primarily in international trade, and are written orders by one person to his bank to pay the bearer a specific sum on a specific date.
Bills of exchange
Bills of exchange are used primarily in international trade, and are written orders by one person to his bank to pay the bearer a specific sum on a specific date.
______ is a contract for delivering goods by one party to another to be held in trust for a specific period and returned when the purpose is ended. ii.
Bailment
Bailment is a contract for delivering goods by one party to another to be held in trust for a specific period and returned when the purpose is ended. ii.
______ are regarded in law as together making up the 'owner.' Any action against them (pertaining to that account) is made against jointly and not individually (severally).
Joint holders of an account
Joint holders of an account are regarded in law as together making up the 'owner.' Any action against them (pertaining to that account) is made against jointly and not individually (severally).
______ is the bank which negotiates the bills or drafts under the letter of credit.
negotiating bank
v) The negotiating bank is the bank which negotiates the bills or drafts under the letter of credit.
______ is an order addressed to the warehouse keeper where the goods are stored to deliver the goods mentioned therein to a particular person.
'delivery order
The 'delivery order' is an order addressed to the warehouse keeper where the goods are stored to deliver the goods mentioned therein to a particular person.
______ is a contract by which one party promises to save the other from loss caused to him by the conduct of either the promisor himself, or by the conduct of any other person.
contract of indemnity
A contract of indemnity is a contract by which one party promises to save the other from loss caused to him by the conduct of either the promisor himself, or by the conduct of any other person.
______ is the property that is pledged by a loan beneficiary towards securing the facility.
Collateral security
Collateral security is the property that is pledged by a loan beneficiary towards securing the facility.
______ means an amount that can be determined in relation to the face value of the instrument.
Fixed amount for payment
Fixed amount for payment means an amount that can be determined in relation to the face value of the instrument.
